variant.changelog:
Gratis 0.1.0.7

First submission to the testing channel.

- A flat, minimal replacement for the in-game map: search, lenses, filters, quest log and window presets.
- Click a quest marker to open that quest in the Quest Log.
- Instance quests point at the entry NPC or door.
- A separate map size and position inside duties.
variant.description: Replaces the in-game map with a flat, minimal ImGui map: search, lenses, filters, travel offers, window presets and dozens of small QoL tweaks. Based on Mappy by MidoriKami and harbingerftw. Open with /gratis.
